source.title: Honest Coffee Guide: Wilfa Svart grind settings (dot positions, 1 = finest)

procedure.en: There is no user zero. Rotate the hopper; the dial is printed with brew-method zones from coarse to fine (STEEP, FRENCH PRESS, FILTER, AEROPRESS, MOCCA) with fine-tune dots between them. Position 1 is the finest dot.
procedure.pt-BR: Não há zero a ser ajustado pelo usuário. Gire o reservatório; o dial é impresso com zonas por método, do grosso ao fino (STEEP, FRENCH PRESS, FILTER, AEROPRESS, MOCCA), com pontos de ajuste fino entre elas. A posição 1 é o ponto mais fino.

notes: Not espresso capable: Wilfa says the finest setting is roughly medium; Honest Coffee Guide's espresso row 1–2 is nominal. Values are Honest Coffee Guide's 18 dot positions (1 = finest, 18 = coarsest) across Wilfa's '5 grinding degrees'. Square Mile's roaster guide (squaremileblog.com/2018/06/26/wilfa-grind-size-guide/) is keyed to the printed letters: AeroPress = 'R' of AEROPRESS; V60 250 ml = 'P', 500 ml = first 'E', 750 ml = dot between FILTER and AEROPRESS; Clever = between 'O' and 'P'; French press = 'O' of AEROPRESS; batch brewer = 'T' of FILTER. Honest Coffee Guide's computed slope is about 46 µm per dot ((1100 − 310) ÷ 17), a particle-size estimate, not burr travel. Wilfa product page: wilfa.com/products/svart-aroma.
